This site is an automated .NET news aggregator. It gathers articles from RSS feeds and videos from YouTube channels, with related coverage of cloud computing, containers, DevOps, and AI. Browse the latest stories or search and filter the 180-day archive.
News feeds are refreshed every 3 hours. The videos section is scheduled to update daily at 07:15 UTC with recent videos; scheduled runs can start later than the configured time.
The AI for .NET Developers hub brings together practical AI topics, learning paths, and selected .NET AI SDK and framework releases. Community Pulse combines technical links and insights from selected .NET accounts on Bluesky and Mastodon with linked discussions from r/dotnet over the last seven days. You can search all posts or filter by platform. The Reddit pilot adds up to four links per day; its authors are not selected Community Pulse accounts.
You can filter by topic and content type, bookmark stories, hide sources, track read items, and choose a compact layout. These preferences are stored locally in your browser; no account is required.
To suggest an RSS feed, YouTube channel, or community account, see Contribute. For issues or questions, reach out on GitHub or LinkedIn.

body:
Have a .NET-related blog or YouTube channel to suggest? Contributions from creators and readers are welcome. Sources should regularly publish content relevant to .NET developers; related cloud, DevOps, and AI content is welcome when it is useful to that audience.
Suggest an RSS feed or YouTube channel Check the existing Sources to avoid duplicates. Add one .yml file for the source in the repository's data/ folder, using the existing files as examples. Include Feed (the public RSS URL or YouTube channel URL), Title (the source name), and Website (the source's website URL). Description and Author are optional. Open a pull request with a brief explanation of the source's relevance to .NET developers. For example:
1Feed: https://www.mytechramblings.com/index.xml 2Title: My technical ramblings 3Website: https://www.mytechramblings.com/ 4Description: Technical ramblings from a software engineer 5Author: Carlos Pons To propose an account for Community Pulse, open a GitHub issue with its Bluesky or Mastodon profile and why its posts would be relevant. Community accounts are curated separately from the data/ feed files; do not add them there.
Suggestions are reviewed for fit and reliability. Submission does not guarantee inclusion or publication of every post.
